_about: Items that can no longer be obtained in a playthrough once a condition holds (closed quests, exclusive choices, areas that change). Used by the inventory's 'No tengo' mode: an item matching a rule and not owned is shown as 'ya no disponible'. Conditions: {"boss": "<boss name as in flags.json>"} = that boss is defeated; {"owns": "<item name>"} = the character owns that item (exclusive rewards). Names are the English ones from items.json. Keep rules to well-documented cases; a wrong rule hides a real pickup. Checked against a finished save: the Sellen/Jerren rewards (Shard Spiral, Glintstone Kris, Eccentric's set) are NOT exclusive, so they are not listed.

why.es: Rykard vencido: los contratos de Volcano Manor (recompensas de Tanith) se cierran.
why.en: Rykard defeated: the Volcano Manor contracts (Tanith's rewards) are closed.

why.en: Leyndell is now the Ashen Capital: the dragon's spear can no longer be picked up.
